name: copy-button
title: Copy Button
description: An icon button that copies a value to the clipboard and flashes a green check. Failures show a red cross instead of throwing.
usage: <CopyButton value="pastebin get Xk2p9 hub" label="Copy command" />
notes: Uses the Clipboard API and falls back to a hidden textarea on insecure origins. The result is announced through a polite live region.
